question: You mentioned that you have a lot of eye masks at home, but what would make you happy to receive nowadays?
answer:
I'd still be perfectly happy with an eye mask, since I do use them, but... a ballpoint pen that actually works. (laughs)

I'm joking now, but fan letters! I really, really love receiving fan letters. If you send me one, I'll do something in return, so I'd be really happy if you sent me a fan letter!
